title: Paul McCartney live: Königsplatz, Munich | 2003
content:
Paul McCartney performed an outdoor show at the Königsplatz in Munich, Germany, on 17 May 2003.

It was the 27th date of the Back In The World Tour, which lasted for 33 dates between March and June 2003, and the first of two consecutive nights in Munich.

McCartney’s band was Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens (vocals, keyboards, guitar, percussion, harmonica), Brian Ray (vocals, guitar, bass), Rusty Anderson (vocals, guitar), and Abe Laboriel Jr (vocals, drums).
